comment: Deployment catalog v1 (grill 2026-08-12, D4): the six standard-family Face-Off deployment styles; only the standard family ships in v1. Zones are polygons in centered table inches (table 72x48, x in [-36,36], z in [-24,24]); player 1 owns the z-negative side. Every zone is a list of polygons (list of list of [x,z] pairs), even where one polygon suffices, so multi-part zones like disordered share the same shape as the rest. Wording is our own; geometry follows the official standard-style diagrams.
